home.title: AFA Bernat Desclot School
home.subtitle: Families Association
home.description: The AFA is the representative body of families at the school and actively participates in the management and educational model, serving as a direct communication bridge between families, management and teaching staff.

about.title: About Us
about.description: The AFA is the representative body of families at the school and actively participates in the management and educational model, serving as a direct communication bridge between families, management and teaching staff.
about.descriptionSecondary: The AFA is made up of a board of volunteer mothers and fathers, who dedicate part of their time to ensure that our school is the school we want for our daughters and sons.
about.finalMessage: The activity carried out by the AFA benefits all our sons and daughters.
about.missionText: We work to improve the education and wellbeing of all students at Bernat Desclot school.
about.familiesText: We are parents who work together to improve our children's educational experience.
about.goalsText: Foster participation, organize activities and collaborate with Bernat Desclot for students' wellbeing.
about.commitmentText: We are committed to quality education and a positive and enriching school environment.

services.title: The AFA exclusively manages different services such as:

morningCare.title: Morning care service
morningCare.description: From 7.45 to 9am from the first day of school.

afternoonCare.title: Afternoon care service
afternoonCare.description: In June, when intensive schedule begins.

books.title: Books and Materials
books.description: Reservation and distribution of textbooks, tracksuits and school t-shirts.

council.title: School Council
council.description: Active participation in the School Council and joint collaboration with the school.

camps.title: Camps and colonies
camps.description: Extracurricular activities; summer, spring and winter camps and colonies, currently with Kampi ki Pugui association.

daily.title: Daily extracurricular activities
daily.description: Daily extracurricular activities with the Sports Council from this 2025-26 school year.

events.title: Parties and Workshops
events.description: Organization of different parties and workshops: Chestnut and Halloween party in October; Christmas party with the visit of the Three Kings; hot chocolate, costume contest and participation in the neighborhood parade at Carnival; bookmark and literary contest at Sant Jordi; foam party, brotherhood dinner and collaboration in the farewell of 6th grade students. (provided there are volunteers and they can be organized)

more.title: And so much more...
more.description: Our volunteer team is always working to bring new activities and projects to the school.

solidarity.title: Solidarity Projects
solidarity.description: We also promote participation in solidarity projects: we collaborate with the childhood cancer association Afanoc, participate in the clothing collection organized by Fundació Glorr and in the food collection for Red Cross.

discounts.title: Member Discounts
discounts.description: Enjoy exclusive discounts at local shops and services for being an AFA member. Download the complete list of available discounts.

extracurricular.title: Extracurricular Activities
extracurricular.description: Summer, spring and winter camps with Kampi ki Pugui. Daily activities with the Sports Council from the 2025-26 school year

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.info: Would you like to collaborate with AFA? Do you have ideas for new activities? Write to us! We're always happy to receive suggestions and welcome new families. 💌
contact.atSchoolText: Ask at the office for AFA!

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At AFA Bernat Desclot School we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.
privacy.dataCollectedText: This website does not collect personal data from users. If we implement contact forms in the future, we will only collect the data necessary to respond to your queries.
privacy.cookiesText: We use Google Analytics to analyze website usage. You can find more information in our Cookie Policy.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to access, rectify, delete, limit processing, data portability and object to the processing of your personal data.

cookiesPolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiesPolicy.whatText: Cookies are small text files that websites store on your device to remember information about your visit.
cookiesPolicy.necessaryText: These cookies are essential for the website to function and cannot be disabled.
cookiesPolicy.analyticsText: We use Google Analytics to understand how users interact with our website. This data helps us improve the user experience.
cookiesPolicy.manageText: You can manage your cookie preferences at any time by clicking the cookie settings button in the footer.
